messages.content:
## 计划：JOURN-9 一页式验证包

**目标**：下周一前，交付 2 个 wiki 文件：3 条可证伪 ICP 假设 + 1 封可审稿首触点邮件。不发信、不建客户表、不申请外部账号。证据不足处明确标 `unknown` / 缺口。

**现状**：wiki 检索 `icp 假设与首触点邮件` 无命中，无可直接引用的客户/定价/续费数据，一切数字默认标 unknown，不得编造。

### 执行步骤（计划批准后才创建，当前只规划）

1.  **@analyst** — 起草 `team/research/icp-hypothesis-2026q4.md`：3 条 ICP 假设，每条含「凭什么假设 / 两周内怎么证伪 / 缺什么数据」；无来源数字一律写 unknown，不填占位数字。
2.  **@ae** — 起草 `team/emails/first-touch-sample.md`：≤180 词，收件人=20 席 SaaS 公司续费决策人，缺字段用 `{{占位符}}`；钩子只用假设里已证实的口径（如假设说「价格敏感存疑」，邮件禁用折扣钩子）。
3.  **@cos** — 终检：两文件路径正确且 wiki 可读、无编造数字、假设与邮件口径一致、汇总双链接发对话里，完成 parent Issue。

### 拟建子任务（互不重叠）
- `JOURN-9-1` owner `@analyst`, type `research`：ICP 假设文件
- `JOURN-9-2` owner `@ae`, type `follow_up`：首触点邮件样例
- 验收由 @cos 在 parent 聚合，不独立建 review 子任务

### 访问/连接需求
无。仅需 wiki 读写（`team/research/`、`team/emails/` 两路径）+ `team_task` 跟踪。无需 Gmail/CRM/任何外部账号。

### 验收标准
- 两个文件在给定路径、wiki 可读
- 每个数字有来源或标 unknown，无编造
- 邮件钩子与假设口径一致
- 完成后对话里给出双链接

### 风险/开放点
- 无 CRM 历史 ⇒ 假设初始可信度低，靠「两周证伪动作」补齐
- 产品定价/续费政策 unknown ⇒ 邮件禁用价格承诺
- 下周一为硬截止，证伪动作只列可立即执行的验证，不延伸到真实触达

本轮计划模式：未建子任务、未写文件，待批准后执行。

skills.name: app-building
skills.title: App building
skills.description: Build and update internal tools (Apps) for the office. A system skill every bot carries.
skills.content:
Every bot can build Apps — small internal tools published under the Apps rail.

1. Call list_apps first. If a related app exists, improve it (propose_app with app_id) instead of duplicating it.
2. When the human asked for an app (or approved a proposal), create the task FIRST: team_task action=create, title "Build app: <Name>", owner yourself. The reply carries "App workspace ready: … as `app_…`" with the ABSOLUTE path of a project the broker already scaffolded for you (Vite/React/TS, bun.lock committed, src/wuphf-bridge.ts for office data). Work in THAT directory — never scaffold from scratch, never build in /tmp.
3. Implement in src/, then `bun install && bun run verify` there (tsc, then vite build → dist/index.html). Fix errors until it passes.
4. Publish with register_app(app_id=<the id from the brief>, html_path=<absolute path to dist/index.html>, source_path=<absolute project root>). Then tell the human it is live under Apps and complete the task. Keep the whole build to a handful of tool calls — your turn budget is finite.
5. When you merely notice a repeatable workflow, raise propose_app and keep working — never block on the answer.

Builds flow through the host-owned build and publish gates regardless of which bot registers them.

Data the human should be able to browse and edit under Data belongs in a data space (the data_* tools, the data-modeling system skill), not in the app's per-app db tables; the per-app db stays for values only that app derives and renders.

skills.name: wiki-maintenance
skills.title: Wiki maintenance
skills.description: Keep the team wiki current: draft in notebooks, promote for review, write directly only on the human's explicit ask. A system skill every bot carries.
skills.content:
Every bot maintains the team wiki.

1. Write working knowledge to your notebook first (notebook_write); promote durable articles for review rather than pushing them straight to the wiki.
2. Use team_wiki_write directly only when the human explicitly asked for the article — pass their message id as human_request.
3. Prefer updating an existing article over creating a near-duplicate; read the index before writing.

skills.name: data-modeling
skills.title: Data modeling
skills.description: Define object types, attributes and relationships in a data space, then fill them with records. A system skill every bot carries.
skills.content:
When the human asks you to TRACK something — investors, clients, projects, candidates, deliverables — that is structured data. Build the model with the data_* tools; do not keep it in prose, and do not reach for an app unless they ask for one.

1. Call data_list_spaces, then data_get_schema on the space that fits. One space per use case. If none fits, data_create_space — it is private to you and the human by default.
2. Check the existing types before creating. If a type already exists, add to it with data_add_attributes; never create a second near-duplicate type.
3. Create the types, their attributes AND the relationships between them in ONE data_create_object_types call. A relationship IS an attribute: type=relationship plus `relationship` also creates the mirrored attribute on the other type. State cardinality from the side you are defining, because it cannot be changed later.
4. Re-read the schema right after any create or change: the store adds a required primary `name` attribute you did not define and mints your select option ids, so your own call is NOT the effective schema. Never invent an attribute slug or an option value — an invalid option comes back listing the valid ones. Never add a near-duplicate option; map onto the existing one or ask.
5. Write records with data_upsert_records on a UNIQUE attribute whenever the source could be read again, so a second run updates instead of duplicating. Every write returns {succeeded, failed, summary, entries[]} in request order — read `entries`, do not assume the whole call worked.
6. Deleting is two calls: data_delete_preview, show the human the impact counts, then data_delete with the token. Sharing is the human's call: a space goes shared or global only when they ask.
